svg.title: CV Protocol v5 — inner exploration, outer confirmation
svg.desc: Procedural schematic of ROGII CV Protocol v5: the staged development ladder on folds F0-F3, the checksummed global freeze, the sealed nested run of 10 pair models and 5 outer models, the joint reveal and what it reports, the Accept/Hold/Reject boundary, manual parent activation, the selection-clean role matrix, and how an accepted candidate is weighted and packaged.
svg.text: CV Protocol v5 — inner exploration, outer confirmation
Unlimited target-derived search on F0–F3; one protected five-fold measurement per batch, opened once and spent on contact.

g.text: 2 short run on one inner role

svg.text: family; every trial and choice logged.

g.text: for outer fold h, the recipe is
chosen by the other four folds
after freeze, F4 labels may train
needs role map, five outer caches,
opens all five folds at once,
then the agent edits the registry:

svg.text: Preregistered whole-well split, queried only at milestones. Once its
result changes a decision it is reclassified as development evidence,
and a fresh grouping must be registered before the freeze.
A held fold may not choose the checkpoint, decoder,
postprocessor or weight used to predict itself.
20 inner roles, 10 unique excluded-pair runs, 5 outer runs.
Weight mode, preregistered before the run
or nonnegative ridge — maximum weight 0.20 either way
estimated only inside that fold's four-fold training pool,
under original / balanced / independent groupings; take the
median, round down to the grid, apply unchanged to fold h
five outer checkpoints, each checksummed; inner pair models
never shipped; a zero-weight file may be omitted; no refit.
each generation a correction applied to the one before it — v20 itself is never retrained
11 residual nets on cached v20 components
6 batches maximum · 5 candidate families per batch
1 joint outer reveal per batch — 5 spent, 1 remaining
a spent boundary is replaced by a new target-free grouping
Source: COOKBOOK.md and limited_query_cv/CV_PROTOCOL_V5.md, CV Protocol v5 revision 14 · trial, reveal and batch counts from cv_query_ledger_v5.json at snapshot commit c34b9212
